scope: Cursor Agent-like sidebar search result targeting and thread open behavior
userFinding: The current sidebar still behaves differently from Cursor Agent across left-sidebar functions; old chats must stay reachable after New Agent.

observed: Cursor Agent sidebar keeps historical chats visible in the same repository after New Agent.
Repository rows expose Pin plus Archive for completed chats, and draft rows expose Pin plus Discard.
Selecting a concrete chat row targets that chat, not only its generic agent/scenario.

sciforgeBrowserEvidence.isolation: Dedicated Vite dev server with VITE_SCIFORGE_INSTANCE_ID=sidebar-e2e and a temporary workspace path.
actions: Reloaded the isolated sidebar after the search-target fix.
Searched for New chat and confirmed the sidebar search results expose a Draft chat result.
Clicked the Draft chat search result and confirmed it targets the visible draft row without throwing or navigating away.
limitations: The Browser runtime exposes a read-only page evaluation scope, so localStorage could not be seeded directly for destructive Archive/Delete live clicks.
The isolated app had no writer/runtime-backed completed chat available, so archived/deleted search opening was verified through focused model tests instead of a destructive live click.

implementation: Sidebar search matches now carry sanitized project target ids, session ids, and thread state.
Clicking a search result resolves the target against current sidebar project groups and reuses the same openSidebarThread path as visible rows.
Archived/deleted/retained search matches can now restore or open their concrete session instead of only switching scenario.
Search result target ids are hashed project-target refs and do not expose local absolute workspace paths.
